tasks.label: Start Dev
tasks.detail: Brings Postgres up, runs the dev server (webpack --watch + nodemon), and launches Chrome with the SpotifAIDebug profile and remote-debugging on port 9222.

tasks.label: Dev: Server (npm)
tasks.detail: Brings Postgres up, then runs webpack --watch (client) and nodemon (server) in parallel via concurrently.

tasks.label: Build Production Bundle
tasks.detail: One-shot production webpack build of the client.

tasks.label: Postgres: Up (Docker)
tasks.command: if ((docker ps -a --filter 'name=^spotifai-pg$' --format '{{.Names}}') -eq 'spotifai-pg') { docker start spotifai-pg | Out-Null } else { docker run -d --name spotifai-pg -e POSTGRES_USER=postgres -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=postgres -e POSTGRES_DB=spotifai -v spotifai-pg-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data -p 5432:5432 postgres:16 | Out-Null }; for ($i = 0; $i -lt 30; $i++) { docker exec spotifai-pg pg_isready -U postgres -d spotifai *> $null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Write-Host 'Postgres ready'; exit 0 }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500 }; Write-Error 'Postgres did not become ready within 15s'; exit 1
tasks.detail: Creates the spotifai-pg container if missing, starts it otherwise, then polls pg_isready until the DB accepts connections (up to 15s).

tasks.label: Postgres: Stop (Docker)
tasks.detail: Stops the spotifai-pg container (data survives in the volume).

tasks.label: Postgres: Reset (Docker, destroys data)
tasks.command: docker stop spotifai-pg 2>$null; docker rm spotifai-pg 2>$null; docker volume rm spotifai-pg-data 2>$null; Write-Host 'Container and data volume removed. Run "Postgres: Up" to recreate.'
tasks.detail: DESTRUCTIVE: removes the container AND the data volume. Use when you want a clean DB.

tasks.label: Docker: Force Restart
tasks.command: Write-Host '=== Killing Docker processes ==='; Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.ProcessName -match 'docker|com\.docker|vpnkit' } | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "Stopping $($_.ProcessName) (PID $($_.Id))"; try { Stop-Process -Id $_.Id -Force -ErrorAction Stop } catch { Write-Warning "  Failed: $($_.Exception.Message)" } }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; Write-Host '=== Shutting down WSL ==='; wsl --shutdown; Write-Host '=== Launching Docker Desktop ==='; $exe = 'C:\Program Files\Docker\Docker\Docker Desktop.exe'; if (-not (Test-Path $exe)) { Write-Error "Docker Desktop not found at $exe"; exit 1 }; Start-Process $exe; Write-Host 'Waiting up to 90s for engine to become responsive...'; for ($i = 0; $i -lt 45; $i++) { docker info *> $null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Write-Host "Docker engine ready after $($i*2)s."; exit 0 }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2 }; Write-Error 'Docker engine did not become ready within 90s.'; exit 1
tasks.detail: Force-kills all Docker processes, shuts down WSL, relaunches Docker Desktop, and waits for the engine to become responsive. Use when Docker Desktop fails to appear in the tray.

tasks.label: Chrome: Open Debug
tasks.detail: Waits for http://localhost:3000, then launches Chrome with the SpotifAIDebug profile and --remote-debugging-port=9222. Skips if a debug Chrome is already running on that port. Logic lives in .vscode/scripts/open-chrome-debug.ps1.
